d:
India edged past Korea 2–1 to maintain their winning momentum at the Women’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026.
Goals from Mumtaz Khan (30') and Sunelita Toppo (34') put the hosts in control before India stood firm against a late Korean fightback to claim another crucial three points.
